rationale.scope: Versioned demonstration planning assumptions; not operational rover limits or human safety certification.
rationale.warningSlopeDeg: Highlight edges above 10 degrees while retaining them below the hard route limit.
rationale.routeSlopeLimitDeg: Block native surface slopes above 20 degrees for this first constrained planning demonstration.
rationale.stagingSlopeLimitDeg: Require the entire staging footprint to be relatively flat, at most 5 degrees.
rationale.moveGradeLimitDeg: Separately reject absolute along-move grades above 20 degrees, including all four cardinal side transitions of a diagonal.
rationale.gentleWeight: Dimensionless weight 4: edge length multiplied by 1 + 4*(maximum supercover surface slope/20 degrees)^2. Shortest uses only three-dimensional length.
rationale.time: No walking speed, terrain mobility or operational duration model has been established; estimated time is null.

algorithm.heuristic: horizontal Euclidean distance in projected metres
algorithm.tieBreak: ascending f, then h, then row-major cell index; fixed row/column neighbour order; retain first equal-cost predecessor
algorithm.diagonal: Both side cells and all four endpoint-to-side cardinal transitions must be valid; include both side slopes in the edge maximum.
algorithm.return: Reverse outbound geometry under symmetric passability; recompute signed grades and positive climb.
algorithm.routingFootprint: Point path through conservative native-cell supercover; 10 m staging footprint is checked only at departure, not swept along the walking route.

staging.selection: Within the 50 m Phase 1 candidate square, compared centered 11-by-11 native-cell windows at rows 357..392 and columns 402..437. Row 370 column 406 minimizes maximum slope (tie broken by mean slope, row, column). Its continuous 10 m square touches all 121 cells in that window.
staging.imageReview: Inspected the native optical crop around the candidate square and Home Plate on 14 November 2026. Selected the subdued-texture western portion, away from the stronger ridge to the east; no resolved obstacle or reviewed exclusion intersects the square. Orbital resolution does not establish small-rock, bearing strength or absolute positioning safety.
staging.approvalScope: Demo departure only, contingent on footprint checks and successful routes; no operational approval.

approach.gridDecision: Explicitly adopt the center of native cell (503,554) for this version, rather than the continuous Phase 1 proposal. Save the projected displacement in mission.json; route API itself accepts integer cells and never silently snaps.
approach.approvalScope: Demo approach within the registered 15 m science-context area; check 2 m square with route slope limit. The source observation remains approximate.
